model_selection.reason: Nano model is optimal for CPU/limited GPU training

alternatives.yolov8s.pt: If GPU memory > 4GB, provides better accuracy
alternatives.yolov8m.pt: If GPU memory > 8GB, significantly better accuracy

image_size.note: Use 416 for faster CPU training, 640 for better small object detection

learning_rate.note: Lower LR if training is unstable

focal_loss.note: Helps with hard examples and minority classes

class_imbalance_handling.oversampling: Applied to Theft and Shopping-Cart classes

early_stopping.note: Stop if no improvement for 50 epochs

transfer_learning.strategy: Full fine-tuning from COCO pretrained weights
transfer_learning.note: YOLOv8n.pt provides good initialization for retail objects

theft_detection_optimization.note: Lower confidence for high recall on theft detection

memory_optimization.note: Disk caching saves RAM, essential for CPU training
